title: An agent-graded audit FAIL's repair round WARNs 'findings artifact unreadable' and briefs the builder without the failure block's defects
summary: The repair brief (composeRepairBrief) reads the audit's reasons only from audit-fail-reason.json, which a runner gate writes (persistFloorFailReasons) and, since the doc-only landing (logic-first design §5.14, X2a), the explanation-needs-correction route writes. For every other agent-graded audit FAIL the file is absent, so readContinuationFindings WARNs 'continuation: findings artifact ... unreadable' on each tdd/build dispatch of the round, and the brief carries only the report's findings table (auditorFindingsBrief), not the verdict sentinel's failure-block defects, which are the auditor's machine-readable reasons. The X2a architecture review (2026-09-29) also noted that the X2a record makes a re-author Build that dies before the re-audit digest from the audit's defects rather than the Build error, the same as a floor record already does.
fix: Have composeRepairBrief read phasecontract.ReadFailureBlock(workspace, audit).Defects for an agent-graded FAIL when audit-fail-reason.json is absent (and treat an absent file as expected there, not a WARN), deduplicated against auditorFindingsBrief's titles. Then decide whether the X2a record is still needed for the brief, or only for a continuation's FindingsPath, and whether ensureFailureDigest should prefer the failing phase's own error over a record another phase wrote.
acceptance: A repair round after an agent-graded code-audit-fail with no gate reasons briefs tdd/build with the failure block's defects and logs no 'findings artifact unreadable' WARN
A runner-downgraded FAIL's brief is unchanged (gate reasons first)
The failure digest of a phase that dies inside a repair round names that phase's failure, or the design states why it does not
source: console, 2026-09-29, architecture review of the doc-only-audit-fail-reauthors-the-explanation landing
consumed_by: console landing fix/repair-brief-from-failure-block (2026-09-29): BUILT. One reader, auditRejectionReasons (go/internal/core/repair_brief.go), serves the repair brief and the retry adjudicator: the runner's reasons (CycleState.AuditFailReasons, not the forensic audit-fail-reason.json) when a gate diagnosed the FAIL, byte-identical to before; otherwise the verdict sentinel's failure-block defects (phasecontract.ReadFailureBlock), less any defect restating a briefed finding. No 'findings artifact unreadable' WARN for an agent-graded FAIL (the brief reads no file). The X2a record (recordExplanationCorrection/recordExplanationRound) is removed as a second copy of the defect list, so a re-author Build that dies before the re-audit is digested from its own failure (build|...); a runner-downgraded FAIL keeps its gate record's precedence in ensureFailureDigest, and logic-first design §5.14 states why. The findings header names gate reasons only when they lead. Acceptance: (1) TestRepairRoundDispatch_AnAgentGradedFailBriefsTheDefectsWithoutAWarn, TestComposeRepairBrief_AnAgentGradedFailBriefsItsFailureBlockDefects; (2) TestComposeRepairBrief_AGateRecordKeepsTodaysBriefOverTheFailureBlock (byte guard); (3) TestRunCycle_AReauthorBuildThatDiesIsDigestedFromItsOwnFailure plus §5.14's gate-precedence statement.
